nominee.shortDescription: Also known as Lady Agnes, she's Minecraft's Game Director
nominee.longerDescription: To celebrate the release of my first Minecraft video, here's an important figure for the game 🤪. She's Swedish, and has been working at Mojang since 2016, getting promoted to Game Director in 2021. She's a public figure as she's one of the two higher-ups who always appear in the Minecraft Live shows (showing off what's next for the game 1-2x a year). I always thought she's really cute, and you should hear and see her speak, even cutesier than you would think (thinking about it, it may be better for you to avoid her lol). The first few times I thought she's like 25, but actually she was born in 89 🤯 (upon a closer look, wrinkles and such are visible, but still). She has one daughter, multiple cats, and she's very passionate about inclusivity, creativity, and any kind of positive impact the game can make, so overall she's a very positive character.
